title: The Crank
subtitle: sequentialTasks: true
description: The crank is turned in order and the quest insists on it:
`sequentialTasks: true` means the second task cannot be handed in
until the first is -- fittings first, then the turn, and not the
other way round however satisfying the other way sounds.
